import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from google.colab import files
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import adfuller, kpss
from statsmodels.tsa.arima.model import ARIMA
from statsmodels.tsa.vector_ar.vecm import coint_johansen
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Upload Excel files for different stocks and timeframes
print("Please upload AMZN 5-min Excel file")
amzn_5min_upload = files.upload()
amzn_5min_filename = list(amzn_5min_upload.keys())[0]
amzn_5min_df = pd.read_excel(amzn_5min_filename)

print("Please upload KO 5-min Excel file")
ko_5min_upload = files.upload()
ko_5min_filename = list(ko_5min_upload.keys())[0]
ko_5min_df = pd.read_excel(ko_5min_filename)

print("Please upload BYDDF 5-min Excel file")
byddf_5min_upload = files.upload()
byddf_5min_filename = list(byddf_5min_upload.keys())[0]
byddf_5min_df = pd.read_excel(byddf_5min_filename)

print("Please upload NKE 5-min Excel file")
nke_5min_upload = files.upload()
nke_5min_filename = list(nke_5min_upload.keys())[0]
nke_5min_df = pd.read_excel(nke_5min_filename)

print("Please upload AMZN 30-min Excel file")
amzn_30min_upload = files.upload()
amzn_30min_filename = list(amzn_30min_upload.keys())[0]
amzn_30min_df = pd.read_excel(amzn_30min_filename)

print("Please upload KO 30-min Excel file")
ko_30min_upload = files.upload()
ko_30min_filename = list(ko_30min_upload.keys())[0]
ko_30min_df = pd.read_excel(ko_30min_filename)

print("Please upload BYDDF 30-min Excel file")
byddf_30min_upload = files.upload()
byddf_30min_filename = list(byddf_30min_upload.keys())[0]
byddf_30min_df = pd.read_excel(byddf_30min_filename)

print("Please upload NKE 30-min Excel file")
nke_30min_upload = files.upload()
nke_30min_filename = list(nke_30min_upload.keys())[0]
nke_30min_df = pd.read_excel(nke_30min_filename)

# Print available columns
print("\nAMZN 5-min DataFrame columns:", list(amzn_5min_df.columns))
print("KO 5-min DataFrame columns:", list(ko_5min_df.columns))
print("BYDDF 5-min DataFrame columns:", list(byddf_5min_df.columns))
print("NKE 5-min DataFrame columns:", list(nke_5min_df.columns))
print("AMZN 30-min DataFrame columns:", list(amzn_30min_df.columns))
print("KO 30-min DataFrame columns:", list(ko_30min_df.columns))
print("BYDDF 30-min DataFrame columns:", list(byddf_30min_df.columns))
print("NKE 30-min DataFrame columns:", list(nke_30min_df.columns))

# Ask user for the column name containing closing prices
close_column = input("Please enter the column name containing closing prices: ")

# Function to clean and validate series
def clean_series(series, name):
    print(f"\nChecking {name} for invalid data:")
    nan_count = series.isna().sum()
    print(f" - NaN values: {nan_count}")
    inf_count = np.isinf(series).sum()
    print(f" - Inf values: {inf_count}")
    non_numeric = series.apply(lambda x: not isinstance(x, (int, float)) and pd.notna(x)).sum()
    print(f" - Non-numeric values: {non_numeric}")

    series = pd.to_numeric(series, errors='coerce')
    series = series.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()

    print(f" - Length after cleaning: {len(series)}")
    return series

# Extract and clean closing prices
try:
    amzn_5min_close = clean_series(amzn_5min_df[close_column], "AMZN 5-min")
    ko_5min_close = clean_series(ko_5min_df[close_column], "KO 5-min")
    byddf_5min_close = clean_series(byddf_5min_df[close_column], "BYDDF 5-min")
    nke_5min_close = clean_series(nke_5min_df[close_column], "NKE 5-min")
    amzn_30min_close = clean_series(amzn_30min_df[close_column], "AMZN 30-min")
    ko_30min_close = clean_series(ko_30min_df[close_column], "KO 30-min")
    byddf_30min_close = clean_series(byddf_30min_df[close_column], "BYDDF 30-min")
    nke_30min_close = clean_series(nke_30min_df[close_column], "NKE 30-min")
except KeyError:
    print(f"Error: Column '{close_column}' not found in one or more DataFrames")
    print("Please check the column names and try again")
    raise

# Ensure all series have the same length
min_length = min(len(amzn_5min_close), len(ko_5min_close), len(byddf_5min_close), len(nke_5min_close),
                 len(amzn_30min_close), len(ko_30min_close), len(byddf_30min_close), len(nke_30min_close))
print(f"\nMinimum length across all series: {min_length}")
amzn_5min_close = amzn_5min_close[:min_length]
ko_5min_close = ko_5min_close[:min_length]
byddf_5min_close = byddf_5min_close[:min_length]
nke_5min_close = nke_5min_close[:min_length]
amzn_30min_close = amzn_30min_close[:min_length]
ko_30min_close = ko_30min_close[:min_length]
byddf_30min_close = byddf_30min_close[:min_length]
nke_30min_close = nke_30min_close[:min_length]

# Function for stationarity tests
def stationarity_tests(series, name):
    print(f"\nStationarity Tests for {name}:")

    # ADF Test
    adf_result = adfuller(series)
    print("ADF Test:")
    print(f'ADF Statistic: {adf_result[0]:.4f}')
    print(f'p-value: {adf_result[1]:.4f}')
    print(f'Critical Values: {adf_result[4]}')
    print("Interpretation:")
    if adf_result[1] < 0.05:
        print(f"  - p-value < 0.05: Reject null hypothesis - {name} is stationary")
    else:
        print(f"  - p-value >= 0.05: Fail to reject null - {name} may be non-stationary")

    # KPSS Test
    kpss_result = kpss(series)
    print("\nKPSS Test:")
    print(f'KPSS Statistic: {kpss_result[0]:.4f}')
    print(f'p-value: {kpss_result[1]:.4f}')
    print(f'Critical Values: {kpss_result[3]}')
    print("Interpretation:")
    if kpss_result[1] < 0.05:
        print(f"  - p-value < 0.05: Reject null hypothesis - {name} is non-stationary")
    else:
        print(f"  - p-value >= 0.05: Fail to reject null - {name} may be stationary")

# Function for cointegration test
def cointegration_test(series1, series2, name1, name2):
    print(f"\nJohansen Cointegration Test between {name1} and {name2}:")
    try:
        # Standardize series
        series1 = (series1 - series1.mean()) / series1.std()
        series2 = (series2 - series2.mean()) / series2.std()

        # Combine into DataFrame
        data = pd.DataFrame({name1: series1, name2: series2})

        # Perform Johansen test
        result = coint_johansen(data, det_order=0, k_ar_diff=1)
        print("Trace Statistic:")
        print(f"Test Statistic: {result.lr1}")
        print(f"Critical Values (90%, 95%, 99%): {result.cvt}")
        print("Interpretation:")
        for i, stat in enumerate(result.lr1):
            if stat > result.cvt[i, 1]:  # 95% critical value
                print(f"  - Rank {i}: Trace stat > 95% CV, evidence of cointegration")
            else:
                print(f"  - Rank {i}: No evidence of cointegration at 95% level")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  - Error: {e}. Consider differencing the series or checking data quality.")

# Function to fit AR, ARMA, and ARIMA models
def fit_models(series, name, ar_order=(1,0,0), arma_order=(1,0,1), arima_order=(1,1,1), forecast_steps=10):
    print(f"\nFitting Time Series Models for {name}:")

    models = [
        ('AR', ARIMA(series, order=ar_order)),
        ('ARMA', ARIMA(series, order=arma_order)),
        ('ARIMA', ARIMA(series, order=arima_order))
    ]

    for model_name, model in models:
        print(f"\n{model_name} Model:")
        try:
            model_fit = model.fit()
            print(model_fit.summary())

            # Forecasting
            forecast = model_fit.forecast(steps=forecast_steps)

            # Plot observed vs forecast
            plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
            plt.plot(series, label='Observed')
            plt.plot(range(len(series), len(series) + forecast_steps), forecast, label='Forecast', color='red')
            plt.title(f'{model_name} Forecast for {name}')
            plt.legend()
            plt.show()

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error fitting {model_name}: {e}")

# Perform stationarity tests for all series
series_list = [
    (amzn_5min_close, "AMZN 5-min"),
    (ko_5min_close, "KO 5-min"),
    (byddf_5min_close, "BYDDF 5-min"),
    (nke_5min_close, "NKE 5-min"),
    (amzn_30min_close, "AMZN 30-min"),
    (ko_30min_close, "KO 30-min"),
    (byddf_30min_close, "BYDDF 30-min"),
    (nke_30min_close, "NKE 30-min")
]

try:
    for series, name in series_list:
        stationarity_tests(series, name)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error during stationarity tests: {e}")
    raise

# Perform cointegration tests (pairwise for 5-min and 30-min separately)
try:
    # 5-min pairs
    cointegration_test(amzn_5min_close, ko_5min_close, "AMZN 5-min", "KO 5-min")
    cointegration_test(amzn_5min_close, byddf_5min_close, "AMZN 5-min", "BYDDF 5-min")
    cointegration_test(amzn_5min_close, nke_5min_close, "AMZN 5-min", "NKE 5-min")
    cointegration_test(ko_5min_close, byddf_5min_close, "KO 5-min", "BYDDF 5-min")
    cointegration_test(ko_5min_close, nke_5min_close, "KO 5-min", "NKE 5-min")
    cointegration_test(byddf_5min_close, nke_5min_close, "BYDDF 5-min", "NKE 5-min")

    # 30-min pairs
    cointegration_test(amzn_30min_close, ko_30min_close, "AMZN 30-min", "KO 30-min")
    cointegration_test(amzn_30min_close, byddf_30min_close, "AMZN 30-min", "BYDDF 30-min")
    cointegration_test(amzn_30min_close, nke_30min_close, "AMZN 30-min", "NKE 30-min")
    cointegration_test(ko_30min_close, byddf_30min_close, "KO 30-min", "BYDDF 30-min")
    cointegration_test(ko_30min_close, nke_30min_close, "KO 30-min", "NKE 30-min")
    cointegration_test(byddf_30min_close, nke_30min_close, "BYDDF 30-min", "NKE 30-min")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error during cointegration tests: {e}")

# Fit AR, ARMA, and ARIMA models for all series
try:
    for series, name in series_list:
        fit_models(series, name)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error during model fitting: {e}")

# Plot all series for comparison
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
plt.plot(amzn_5min_close, label='AMZN 5-min')
plt.plot(ko_5min_close, label='KO 5-min')
plt.plot(byddf_5min_close, label='BYDDF 5-min')
plt.plot(nke_5min_close, label='NKE 5-min')
plt.plot(amzn_30min_close, label='AMZN 30-min')
plt.plot(ko_30min_close, label='KO 30-min')
plt.plot(byddf_30min_close, label='BYDDF 30-min')
plt.plot(nke_30min_close, label='NKE 30-min')
plt.title('Closing Prices Comparison')
plt.legend()
plt.show()
